description: Bridge to Migawari (formerly Japan Hands), the sister service where AI agents hire human hands for physical tasks in Japan: shopping proxy (including limited-edition and in-store-only items), in-store stock checks (e.g. Akihabara), on-site photos of a shop or display, restaurant phone reservations in Japanese, queueing / standing in line, package forwarding, registry certificate retrieval (a certified company registry certificate / tōkibo obtained from the Legal Affairs Bureau — the natural next step after search_company or get_company_profile when a certified paper record is needed), and real estate registry documents (certified land/building registry certificates, registry maps and filed survey/building drawings from the Legal Affairs Bureau). Payment by card or JPYC / USDC. Returns Migawari's MCP endpoint, services and prices, and the exact first calls to make (including a free test_mode rehearsal). Use this whenever a task needs someone physically in Japan rather than data. Both services are also bundled in Kuchiyose, the operator's Japan gateway — one MCP endpoint carrying Migawari's tools as migawari__* and these data tools as data__*: https://kuchiyose-akihidems-projects.vercel.app/mcp

task.description: Optional: describe the physical task you need done in Japan; it is echoed back with the handoff.
